description: This source file defines the 'LanguageScreen' widget for a Flutter app, which allows users to select their preferred language. It includes UI elements such as a title, subtitle, list of language options, and a 'NEXT' button that saves the selection and navigates to an OTP validation screen.

classes.name: LanguageScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a language selection interface, allowing the user to pick a language which is then stored persistently.

classes.name: _LanguageScreenState
classes.description: State class for 'LanguageScreen' managing the selected language state and UI interactions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the language selection screen, including title, subtitle, language list, and the 'NEXT' button.

methods.name: _onNext
methods.description: Handles the action when the user presses 'NEXT', saving preferences and navigating to the OTP validation screen.
